planted.item: The committee decided to keep the break option open and not to waive it in any negotiation.
The committee decided to reject the landlord's demand and ask them to repair the roof.
Helena Marsh will diarise the last date for serving notice and confirm it to the committee in writing next week.
Lena Ekdahl will collect the photographs and repair invoices by the fifteenth.
Helena Marsh will write to the landlord about the roof once Lena sends her the photographs.
The committee discussed whether the insurer will cover the stock damaged by the roof leak.

sources.quote: We decide today to keep the break option open and not to waive it in any negotiation.
sources.speaker: Oskar Lund

sources.quote: The landlord says the roof leak is our responsibility.
sources.speaker: Lena Ekdahl

items.text: The committee discussed the responsibility for the roof leak, with the landlord claiming it is the tenant's responsibility.

sources.quote: Clause six point two puts the structure and roof on the landlord, so we disagree.
sources.speaker: Helena Marsh

items.text: The committee discussed the clause regarding the landlord's responsibility for the roof and structure.

sources.quote: We agree to reject the landlord's demand and ask them to repair the roof.
sources.speaker: Oskar Lund

sources.quote: Let's meet again in a month to decide on the break.
